title: predication-hyperdoctrine
description: A predication-fibration of bilattice-valued fiber algebras over the predicate-category base that additionally satisfies Lawvere's hyperdoctrine conditions in both the knowledge and the truth order; it supplies the spine's first-order quantifier theory and is stated at settling because it carries the closure 2-monad and depends on the bilattice and predicate-category already in scope.

base.description: the predicate-category over which the fibration reindexes; each f : q -> p gives a reindexing functor f*

fiber.description: the bilattice-valued fiber algebra sitting over each base object, supplying the knowledge order and the truth order

closure2Monad.description: the closure 2-monad it carries, the structure settling iterates, placing the hyperdoctrine at the settling level

quantifierAdjoints.description: (B1k/B1t) for every f, exists_f -| f* -| forall_f in BOTH the knowledge order and the truth order

frobeniusReciprocity.description: (B2k/B2t) exists_f(f*alpha meet phi) = alpha meet exists_f phi for both meets meet_k and meet_t

beckChevalley.description: (B3) the canonical map is an iso over every pullback in C, for both adjoint systems

comprehension.description: (B4) the extension functor has a right adjoint {p:-} in both orders, yielding two derived equality predicates (classical and paraconsistent)

fusionFrobeniusFails.description: recorded caveat: knowledge-order Frobenius for the fusion odot fails for three of the four generator classes because odot is non-integral (its absorber f is not the knowledge-bottom the extension fills by)
